title: Human Visual Perception: Colour Perception extension bank

objectives.statement: Define colour vision as wavelength discrimination independent of intensity.
Explain colour as a psychological/neural perceptual code.
Relate visible wavelengths to S, M and L cone coding.
Explain survival and perceptual functions of colour.
Explain colour constancy and restricted-wavelength failure.
Explain trichromatic theory at the cone/photoreceptor level.
Explain opponent-process theory, opponent channels and afterimages.
Compare trichromatic and opponent-process theories using the zone model.
Recognize blue-cone vulnerability, SWAP and source limits for clinical testing protocols.
